name: Gold
description: Standard coin currency of Crownspire, used for academy research, city upkeep, and recruitment.

name: Food
description: Farming yields required for feeding citizens and sustaining the legion armies.

name: Wood
description: Timber harvested from ironwood forests, critical for building and siege engines.

name: Stone
description: Heavy granite block carved from quarries, essential for fortifying walls and castles.

name: Iron
description: High-grade alchemical iron ore, vital for forging weapons and gear upgrades.

name: Royal Crystal
description: Highly condensed magical blue crystals, the premium currency of Crownspire.

name: Aurora Crystal
description: Rare violet crystals mined from aura wells, used for special summoning and blessings.

name: Alliance Honor
description: Tokens earned through collaborative raids and helping allies, redeemable in the Alliance Shop.
